first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. The exact custom query could not be retrieved through this transport, so no target transaction identifier was obtained; Price Paid linked data also does not itself return a registered-title/index-polygon geometry or canonical parcel bbox. Local OpenCode or another authoritative target-specific workflow must bind the exact registered-title/title-boundary polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method was materially changed from the Price Paid report-builder UI to HM Land Registry’s machine-readable Price Paid Linked Data SPARQL endpoint. The official open-data channel supports machine-readable Price Paid Data, but the current transport could not read the exact Forge Cottage query response. No transaction identifier, INSPIRE ID, title polygon, parcel bbox or parcel identifier is inferred from the query text; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
next_modified_method: Do not reuse this exact HMLR Price Paid SPARQL target-query URL/window/fingerprint. Resume only from a target-specific authoritative registered-title/title-boundary polygon, a verified target transaction identifier that can be joined to an unused official INSPIRE-ID lookup record, or another unused official public no-login source that directly returns the Forge Cottage parcel/title geometry; once canonical bbox is bound, open one unused bbox-scoped official DEM/LIDAR tile/index window.
